description: Масштабная цифровая экосистема, в которой несколько команд создают и выпускают UI-функции для разделов Marketplace и Discovery.

hero.title: Я проектирую системы, которые живут дольше трендов
hero.intro: Я <name>Степан Торчян</name> — дизайн-инженер на стыке UI-архитектуры, продуктового дизайна и фронтенд-разработки. С 2016 года помогаю командам превращать сложные идеи в масштабируемые и доступные интерфейсы. Большинство команд разделяют дизайн и реализацию. Я строю мост между ними.
hero.execution: От логики взаимодействия и структуры компонентов до выпуска доступного, многоязычного UI продакшен-уровня — я слежу, чтобы идеи не теряли качество при реализации.
hero.resilience: Хороший дизайн хрупок. Системы делают его устойчивым.

practice.title: Что я делаю на практике
practice.subtitle: От архитектуры к логике взаимодействия и продакшн-коду.

intro: Я постоянно слежу за новым — не потребляя тренды, а проверяя их в продакшене.
Каждый день я работаю с современными дизайн-системами, развивающимися фронтенд-архитектурами и креативными ИИ-инструментами, которые ускоряют исследования, создание медиа и разработку.
От экосистем Figma до редакторов кода, инструментов производительности и генеративных систем — я отношусь к технологиям как к партнёру по мышлению, а не просто к инструменту.
Результат прост: ясность в сложном, структура в хаосе и продукты, готовые к будущему.

hero.title: Picsart Marketplace
hero.subtitle: System Architecture & Design Infrastructure
description: This project required restructuring not only interface visuals, but the entire logic behind how UI components were defined, reused, scaled, and maintained across a multi-team ecosystem.
The objective was systemic coherence - not cosmetic improvement.

timeline.title: Building Interface Systems Since 2016
subtitle: I work at the intersection where design decisions meet technical reality.
My role is to connect intent, system logic, and execution - without losing quality along the way.

steps.title: Product Landscape
blocks: Picsart Marketplace operates as a modular digital ecosystem containing:
Multiple teams were shipping features simultaneously.
However, UI implementation lacked structural standardization.

steps.title: The Real Problem
blocks: The Marketplace did not lack visual quality.
Without a centralized design system and frontend abstraction layer:
Accessibility became reactive instead of structured
This was not a UI redesign task.

architecture.title: Visual System Architecture
architecture.subtitle: A structural breakdown of the design tokens, component governance, spatial logic, and interaction matrices that ensure long-term scalability and implementation clarity.

useCases.title: 1. Typography Scale System
blocks: The typography system was defined semantically, not visually.
Each level corresponds to functional intent:
Display — strategic emphasis and high-level hierarchy
Font sizes, weights, line-heights, and letter-spacing were tokenized and aligned to a vertical rhythm grid.
No arbitrary font sizing was permitted outside the system scale.

useCases.title: 2. Token Architecture
blocks: All visual values were abstracted into tokens to ensure controlled scalability.
Color roles (Primary, Surface, Accent, Error, Success, Warning)
Styling decisions were no longer hard-coded — they were governed.

useCases.title: 3. Component Hierarchy Diagram
blocks: The system was structured across three architectural layers:
Marketplace grids, discovery feeds, filtering panels
This hierarchy ensured that features were assembled from system-approved blocks — not improvised fragments.

useCases.title: 4. Interaction State Matrix
blocks: Every interactive element adhered to a complete state definition:
Focus states were designed with accessibility compliance in mind.
Hover states avoided decorative excess and maintained semantic clarity.
Loading states preserved layout stability to prevent content shift.
This matrix reduced behavioral ambiguity and prevented inconsistent microinteraction patterns across teams.

useCases.title: 5. Layout Grid System
blocks: A responsive grid architecture was implemented to stabilize spatial rhythm.
Modular reduction for tablet and mobile
Spacing adhered strictly to the predefined token scale.
